clips.title: The story
paras: This errand introduces adventurers to Ironforge's gryphon network by tasking them with carrying a bundle of ceremonial tools to the city's gryphon master. Entrusted with the Honorary Picks by Golnir Bouldertoe, the courier must deliver them to Gryth Thurden so they can be dispatched back to Loch Modan.

After traveling from Loch Modan to the Great Forge, couriers receive a bundle of Honorary Picks from Golnir Bouldertoe meant for Brock Stoneseeker's mining apprentices. Rather than making the trek back down the mountain passes on foot, Golnir advises taking advantage of the dwarven gryphon network, sending the messenger across the city to coordinate with Ironforge's master handler.

Gryth Thurden manages the flight roosts within the great mountain hall, connecting Ironforge to dwarven settlements across Khaz Modan. Thurden agrees to arrange transport back to Thorgrum Borrelson in Thelsamar provided the adventurer has already scouted the route and spoken with the local handler there. The delivery teaches fledgling heroes the vital role aerial couriers play in tying the dwarven kingdom together.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Here are the honorary picks for Brock's students. If you've already been to Thelsamar, then you should fly a gryphon back there!
Take the picks to our gryphon master, Gryth Thurden, and speak with him about a ride back to Thelsamar.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You look like you have somewhere to go. Need one of my gryphons?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have to get these to Thelsamar, eh? That won't be a problem. As long as you've already been to Thelsamar and spoken to Thorgrum Borrelson, then you can take one of my gryphons back to him.
